lines.text: A man's wisdom brightens his face, and the Teacher says to keep the king's command because of your oath.
Do not persist in a bad cause, for the king does as he pleases; keeping his command brings no harm.
No man has power over the fire to contain it, and no one has authority over his day of death.
The wicked who used to go in and out of the holy place were buried and cursed in the city.
The Teacher commended enjoying life, since nothing is better under the sun than to eat, drink and be merry.
